title: The earlier study
method: Heikin Ashi flip entries; 9 stops x 6 ratios per timeframe; full costs; one position at a time; flat by 23:20.
headline: Of 189 setups with a stop of 1% or less and at least 100 trades, 9 were positive after costs and none had t above 0.92. Wide stops looked positive only because most trades simply ran to the close, on 25 to 78 trades.
caveat: Each pick below is the best of many tries, so its small plus figure is what luck produces.
